$comment: The files at the top of a delivery, each once, in the operations reference's order: its role, its name or the pattern a build forms it from, when it is written, what it holds, and for a file whose name is fixed or the model's id, what a refusal calls it. src/names.mjs reads the names and the default width, src/projection.mjs the calls, and tools/docs/references.mjs writes the reference's table from the rows. {shared} is the name src/shared.json gives, which the house class reads too. In a pattern, {id} is the model's id, {NN} a plate's number in two digits, {view} its views, {name} a page's name and {width} a width in pixels; {default} in a row's text is the default width.

files.name: images/00-overview.png
files.when: with the edition, when the model states an overview
files.holds: The overview's page at {default} px wide.

files.name: images/{NN}-{view}.png
files.when: with the edition, for each plate
files.holds: Plate `NN`'s page at {default} px wide, numbered from 01 in reading order.

files.name: images/{name}-{width}.png
files.when: with the edition, at each other width `--png` names
files.holds: The overview's or a plate's page at that width.

files.name: figures/{NN}-{view}.png, .svg
files.when: with the edition, for each plate
files.holds: Plate `NN`'s figure and key alone: a PNG on a transparent ground, and an SVG of shapes and outlined glyphs.

files.name: {shared}
files.holds: The model the build read, byte for byte.

files.name: manifest.json
files.holds: The build record, which names every file above with its digest.

files.name: colophon.pdf
files.called: the colophon page an acceptance writes
